## Verification

Describe the checks you performed and their results. Include sanitized error excerpts when a check fails.

## Scope and safety

- Does this change perform new network requests, enlarge scan scope, or change confirmation prompts? Describe the permissions and bounds.
- Does it change the installer, bundled files, or external downloads? Describe sources and integrity checks.
- Does it change exported report data or privacy behavior?

**Never attach API tokens, private scan logs, or credentials.** For sensitive vulnerabilities in PenX, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/SLP-DEV1/PenX/blob/main/SECURITY.md) rather than opening a public PR.
